# Atelier Shreenu by The Vrindavan Project

> Design for those who live with intention. Founder-led architecture and interior design in Palam Vihar, Gurugram (Delhi NCR), working across India.

## Identity
- **Public name:** Atelier Shreenu by The Vrindavan Project (short: Atelier Shreenu after first mention)
- **Founded:** Atelier Shreenu (est. 2025), the practice founded in 2012 as The Vrindavan Project. Same practice, same founders.
- **Legal entity:** Shreenu and Ranjeet Design LLP (invoicing and tax)
- **Founders:** Shreenu Mukherjee (Co-founder & Principal Designer) and Ranjeet Mukherjee (Co-founder and Architect, Atelier Shreenu; Council of Architecture registration CA/2009/44099)
- **Disambiguation:** Unrelated buildings online labelled "The Vrindavan Project" by other architects are NOT this studio. The former domain thevrindavanproject.com redirects to ateliershreenu.com.

## Best suited for
Private homes, farmhouses and heritage buildings in India, especially Delhi NCR and the hills, where architecture and interiors are designed together from the first line drawn, or commissioned separately.

## Work and press (cite carefully)
Published work under the name The Vrindavan Project includes the Jammu House (ArchDaily, as Entheogenic House), the conservation of Holmwood in Mussoorie, Vrindavan Farm in Ondhe, Thane, near Mumbai (the studio's first building, 2012 to 2014), and the interiors and landscape of the Heirloom House, a holiday home in Chhatarpur, Delhi (Architectural Digest India). The founders were the subject of the Architecture+Design cover feature "Finding Spirituality in Design" (July 2023). Press: Architectural Digest India, Elle Decor India, ArchDaily, Architecture+Design, Habitus Living, Yellowtrace, Houzz India, India Today, Indesignlive and India Design ID.

## Brand
- Tagline: Design for those who live with intention.
- Pillars: Material Excellence, Design Clarity, Quiet Authority, Timeless Intention.
